hero.kicker: No fax machine. No subscription. No nonsense.
hero.title: Send a fax from your phone in about a minute.
hero.lede: Upload a PDF, type the number, see the price, pay, done. We keep trying if the line is busy, and we email you the moment it's delivered.
how.title: How it works
how.1.title: Upload your PDF
how.1.body: We count the pages and show you the exact price before you pay a cent.
how.2.title: Pay once
how.2.body: Card, Apple Pay or Google Pay through Stripe. Nothing recurring unless you choose the monthly plan.
how.3.title: We deliver it
how.3.body: Busy line? We retry automatically. You get one email when it's delivered, or one if it truly can't be.
send.title: Send a fax
send.lede: PDF only, up to 5 MB. You'll see the price before you pay.
send.email.hint: For the delivery confirmation. No newsletters.
send.quote.title: Your price
send.terms: By paying you accept the Terms. Single faxes are not refundable once sent.
status.title: Your fax
pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.lede: Pay per fax. Subscribe only if you fax a lot, and leave whenever you like.
account.title: Your account
